rows.check: U108 C130/C131 ground return on top-side PGND copper
rows.detail: top-side GND copper joins ['C130.2', 'C131.2'] to PGND 17-20: False; recorded deviation DEV-U108-CIN-RETURN: SLVSGB4B 11.1 asks for input-capacitor ground returns on localized top-side planes to the PGND pads; here the GND pads of the 1210 bulk capacitors C130/C131 face away from the module (the E1_CONV_IN bar at y 85 lies between) and return through their own GND vias to the solid In1.Cu plane 0.2234 mm under F.Cu. Accepted because the module integrates dual 0402 input capacitors for the high-frequency bypass (SLVSGB4B 11.1), so the fast input loop closes inside the package; turning the capacitors would put the VIN pads away from VIN1/VIN2. EMI and ripple: bench gate, OPEN
rows.label: MODEL
rows.source: TI LM61460 SNVSBD5D (rev. D, July 2022) section 11.1 and figure 11-2 and TI TPSM63606 SLVSGB4B (rev. B, April 2022) section 11.1, re-read 2026-11-14 (fetch-only, not committed); the 2 mm / 5 mm limits are project rules for TI's "as close as possible"

rows.check: U108 C133/C134/C135 ground return on top-side PGND copper
rows.detail: top-side GND copper joins ['C133.2', 'C134.2', 'C135.2'] to PGND 17-20: False; recorded deviation DEV-U108-COUT-RETURN: SLVSGB4B 11.1 asks for output-capacitor ground returns on localized top-side planes to the PGND pads; C133-C135 return through the GND bar at y 71.8 and its vias to In1.Cu (0.2234 mm under F.Cu), next to the module, because the VOUT bars to the VOUT pins and their thermal vias fill the space between the capacitors and PGND pad 20. Output ripple and EMI: bench gate, OPEN
rows.label: MODEL
rows.source: TI LM61460 SNVSBD5D (rev. D, July 2022) section 11.1 and figure 11-2 and TI TPSM63606 SLVSGB4B (rev. B, April 2022) section 11.1, re-read 2026-11-14 (fetch-only, not committed); the 2 mm / 5 mm limits are project rules for TI's "as close as possible"
